title: Prepare and manage a temporary cross-border worker posting
summary: A reviewed posting plan with applicable host-country notifications, social-security evidence and assignment completion records.
outcomes: A reviewed posting plan with applicable host-country notifications, social-security evidence and assignment completion records.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before temporarily sending an employee to perform work in another country, and when assignment facts change.

parts.title: Record sending and host-country assignment facts
parts.guidance: Collect sending employer, host recipient, worker citizenship and residence, habitual work location, destination, duties, duration and previous assignments. Identify intermediaries and private contract evidence; do not classify a posting solely from a travel booking.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Review posting, immigration, tax and social security
parts.guidance: Qualified local reviewers determine the applicable posting, host employment, immigration, payroll-tax and social-security routes for the actual worker and countries. A social-security certificate does not establish permission to work or settle the host-country employment requirements.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Review posting, immigration, tax and social security

parts.title: Prepare the reviewed assignment dossier
parts.guidance: Prepare the assignment terms, host contact, approved pay and working conditions, notification inputs and social-security application evidence. Record deadlines and required documents under the reviewed country instructions and flag missing employee or host information.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Approve the assignment and external applications
parts.guidance: The accountable people owner approves the exact assignment and reviewed notification and application routes. Stop travel or work authorization where prerequisite review or evidence is missing; an internal assignment letter does not replace required external permission.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.scope: Approve the assignment and external applications

parts.title: Complete authorized notifications and verify readiness
parts.guidance: The authorized operator completes required host notifications and social-security or immigration applications through the applicable authorities. Retain accepted certificates and case references, check their coverage against the assignment, and escalate refusals before work begins.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Monitor changes and reconcile the posting end
parts.guidance: Track actual locations, duties and dates against the approved plan and certificate scope. Have the owner review extensions or changed facts, complete required closure updates and reconcile payroll and host records; retain the assignment evidence in the private company system.
